name: The Voidbloom War
description: A contraband spore grows only on a few deadly rim worlds, worked by forced labour under guard. Smugglers carry it into the Oranthi Concord's closed markets; addiction spreads like an epidemic, silver drains out of the Concord, and its commissioner cracks down while the Concord is still strong. Tolerate the police action, pay, back down or go to war: an unequal treaty, the Diet and a random aftermath follow.

flags.name: voidbloom
flags.label: The Voidbloom War
flags.description: Voidbloom worlds in the rim (deadly: they need labour convoys and a garrison), black-market demand that spreads from colony to colony, the Concord's silver drain, the commissioner's crackdown (inspections, blockades, raids, burned fields, occupation), the crackdown crisis, unequal treaties, aftermath branches, Diet motions and the legal era after legalisation.
